name: Yeoreumeul Geonneoneun Nabi
source:
"Perhaps it's because I'm conscious of the gaze of my future self in the autumn."

A protagonist who has lost hope for the future due to a endlessly repeating, mundane life,
and a girl who, trapped in guilt, swims toward an unattainable dream,
and a mysterious being they encounter in an unknown world.

A story of two people and one other, who wished this summer would never end.

Even in a blurry photo, memories were captured.
